items.author: CSenshi
items.body:
# Problem 

The `/to-issues` skill puts `# Parent #` in each generated issue's body, but doesn't use GitHub's sub-issue relationship, so children don't appear in the parent's sub-issue list/progress indicator. Users end up manually attaching each one in the UI.

# Suggested change
After `gh issue create`, also attach the new issue to the parent via the sub-issues REST API (as gh does not expose sub-issues):

This command attached the issues:

```
child_id=$(gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/issues/<child_number> -q .id)
gh api -X POST repos/OWNER/REPO/issues/<parent_number>/sub_issues -F sub_issue_id=$c
items.title: to-issues: attach children as native sub-issues, not just body references
```
